+# The two upper left wells are partly hidden by the arm, so their locations
+# follow the regular 22 mm well spacing visible in the other four positions.

+    1: (-0.1550, 0.1380), 2: (-0.1330, 0.1380),
+    3: (-0.1115, 0.1380), 4: (-0.0893, 0.1380),
+    5: (-0.0677, 0.1380), 6: (-0.0459, 0.1380),

+    15: (-0.0901, 0.1810), 16: (-0.0677, 0.1810),
+}

+
+def pose(xyz, z=None):
+    p = np.asarray(xyz, dtype=float).copy()
+    if z is not None:
+        p[2] = z
+    return np.r_[p, DOWN]
+
+
+def append_segment(rows, start, end):
+    """Append a line at <= 0.21 m/s; rows are 20 Hz ee_pose targets."""
+    a, b = np.asarray(start, float), np.asarray(end, float)
+    dist = float(np.linalg.norm(b[:3] - a[:3]))
+    n = max(1, int(math.ceil(dist / MAX_STEP_M)))
+    for i in range(1, n + 1):
+        t = i / n
+        rows.append(a * (1.0 - t) + b * t)

+def build_practice_probe(start_pose):
+    rows = []
+    current = np.asarray(start_pose, float)
+    hover = 0.115
+    # Parallel stripes on the unscored practice sheet, for checking mark width,
+    # paint response and a safe contact depth before drawing on the main sheet.
+    probe_colors = [3, 6, 7, 10, 16]
+    practice_y_mm = [34, 72, 110, 148, 186]  # paper Y from the far edge
+    for color, y_mm in zip(probe_colors, practice_y_mm):
+        wx, wy = WELLS[color]
+        dip_hover = pose([wx, wy, hover])
+        append_segment(rows, current, dip_hover)
+        dip = pose([wx, wy, 0.0255])
+        append_segment(rows, dip_hover, dip)
+        rows.extend([dip.copy()] * 3)
+        append_segment(rows, dip, dip_hover)
+
+        # Practice origin from practice_cam calibration: far-left corner is
+        # world x=+0.0135925, y=-0.1359035.  Paper X points toward -world y.
+        x_paper = 0.020
+        y_world = -0.1359035 - x_paper
+        x_world = 0.0135925 - y_mm / 1000.0
+        left_high = pose([x_world, y_world, hover])
+        append_segment(rows, dip_hover, left_high)
+        left = pose([x_world, y_world, 0.014])
+        append_segment(rows, left_high, left)
+        right = pose([x_world, y_world - 0.058, 0.014])

+        right_high = pose([x_world, y_world - 0.058, hover])
+        append_segment(rows, right, right_high)

+def run_chunks(robot, actions, *, cameras=None, video="none", video_fps=None,
+               save_dir=None, limit=380):
+    results = []

+        results.append(res)
